description.value: Restaurant 62 is a farm-to-table restaurant in Abbotsford billing itself as the Fraser Valley's top farm-to-table destination, with a menu built around locally sourced ingredients including Fraser Valley meats, Mt. Lehman cheese, and seasonal produce. The kitchen offers lunch, dinner, and happy hour alongside private dining and catering. Touring cyclists would find a full sit-down dining experience with a regionally rooted menu and a catering operation that speaks to the restaurant's scale.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 73m. Total: 3 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and detailed across multiple subpages, confirming an active farm-to-table restaurant; the phone (604) 855-3545 and address 110-33559 Marshall Rd, Abbotsford, BC appear consistently throughout but the street number (33559) differs from the OSM tag (33553), and the OSM community field says Chilliwack while the website and postal code V2S 1K8 both indicate Abbotsford. Menus confirm gluten-free items ('Gluten free cornbread') and vegetarian-suitable dishes; a dedicated takeaway dinner page confirms takeout exists. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific facilities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Street number discrepancy: OSM tag says 33553 Marshall Road but website consistently shows 33559 Marshall Rd across all pages — OSM likely has a typo; website value used.
OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but the website and postal code V2S 1K8 both place the restaurant in Abbotsford, BC.
Phone number (604) 855-3545 appears throughout the website but is absent from OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established farm-to-table restaurant with a full seasonal menu and catering; a worthwhile food stop for touring cyclists in the Abbotsford/Fraser Valley area once address data is corrected.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Lunch menu explicitly lists 'Gluten free cornbread'; multiple vegetarian-suitable dishes appear across menus (roasted heirloom beet salad, mushroom bisque, tomato soup, gnocchi with halloumi add-on option)

wow_evidence: Fraser Valley meats, Mt. Lehman cheese, and seasonal produce

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: Lunch entrées $24-36: pastas, risotto, sandwiches mostly $24-30
